learning_outcomes.text: Students will gain knowledge in the fields of Electrical Machines and Strong Current Electronical Schemes for control of Machines.

syllabus_topics: Principles of operation of DC Machines
Principles of operation of Synchronous Machines
Principles of operation of Induction Machines
Strong Current Electronical Schemes for control of machines

assessment_methods.method: test control on basic topics (written or oral, 15 minutes)

assessment_rules: The assessment is by written exam. There is a test control on basic topics at the beginning of classes, which could be either written or oral, having a 15-minute duration. The test control is meant to help exam presentation.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Industrial Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
